params.amount: The amount of Governance tokens to stake.
The amount of staked tokens to withdraw.

setAuthorizedCaller(address,bool).notice: Grants or revokes permission for an address to call notifyRewardAmount.

setExcludedAddress(address,bool).notice: Registers or unregisters CEX accounts so they do not receive yield distribution.

setProtocolVaults(address).notice: Sets Protocol Community Yield Vault for Staking Fee distribution.

setTreasury(address).notice: Sets the Treasury address for NAV-based staked value computation.

stake(uint256).notice: Stakes Governance tokens into the protocol, applying a 1% entry fee.         Staked tokens gain voting power and accumulate USDC rewards.

totalRewardBalance().notice: Returns the total USDC reward balance currently held in this contract.         Used by Treasury PoR to track real-yield liquidity in the staking pool.

unstake(uint256).notice: Unstakes Governance tokens, subject to a timelock cooldown.         Withdraws principal and removes corresponding voting power.
